connect.body: Icons are made by talking to the agent of your code editor. Link it to NetsuIcon with this command.
connect.ask: Then ask it, for instance: "make a bell icon that rings on hover".

typeHint.action: Hover, then click: the action plays and the icon comes back to rest.
typeHint.switch: Hover, then click: the icon goes on and stays on. A second click turns it off.
typeHint.state: It moves by itself for as long as the state lasts.
typeHint.arrival: It plays once, when it appears.
typeHint.still: This icon has no animation yet.

pack.title: Pack {{name}}
pack.empty: This pack has no icon yet.
pack.advice: Advice, not errors: an icon may depart from its pack on purpose.

lint.off_palette: {{got}} is not in the palette. Use {{want}}.
lint.stroke_width: stroke of {{got}}; the pack draws with {{want}}.
lint.duration: lasts {{got}} ms; for this reaction the pack asks for {{want}} ms.
lint.translate: moves {{got}} units; the pack stops at {{want}}.
lint.no_hover: reacts to a click but not to a hover.
lint.no_click: reacts to a hover but not to a click.

empty.title: No icon yet
empty.offlineBody: Start it from the project folder with this command.

stage.liveHint: The icon answers the pointer and the click, as in a real page.
stage.scrub: Move through the animation by hand
stage.copyRef: Copy the reference of this icon, to paste to the agent
